summary: Visual summary of a draw with a winner provided by the caller, without selection logic.
whenToUse: Showing the outcome of a draw already determined by the application.
Presenting the raffle title and the number of participants.
whenNotToUse: Randomly selecting a winner or running a draw procedure.
Managing entries, persistence or backend state.

props.name: winner
props.description: External winner; null shows the empty state.

props.name: entryCountLabel
props.description: Localizable label with singular and plural forms.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level; the winner's heading uses the next level.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Custom text when winner is null.

accessibility: The section is named by its title and uses headings in hierarchical order.
The winner is rendered by WinnerReveal; the no-winner state is visible text.
The component starts no animation or random selection.
responsive: The summary spans its container and lets long content wrap.
customization: Uses the theme's --dc-* tokens; className and HTML attributes are forwarded to the section.
commonMistakes: Expecting the component to draw the winner: always pass the result determined by the application.
limits: Does not handle entries, randomness, persistence or backend.
